extracted.intended_audience: students and scholars of philosophy; readers of John Locke
extracted.subtask_short: analysis of Locke on space and duration
extracted.subtask_description: An excerpt from John Locke's Essay Concerning Human Understanding (chapters on space, vacuum, motion, duration, and measures of time). The text develops Locke's distinctions between space and body, the possibility of vacuum, and the origin and measurement of duration and time.
